coverage_note: Roughly the first few minutes of a 2h54m lecture were readable: the definition of combinatorics, the ATM-PIN motivation and the syllabus list of counting techniques. The teaching of the individual rules was past the retrieval cut.
concepts: Combinatorics is 'the art of counting' - count how many objects have a property without enumerating them.
Motivating example: 4-digit ATM PINs = 10 x 10 x 10 x 10 = 10000.

The course's technique list: sum rule, product rule, subtraction rule, bijection rule, pigeonhole, permutations and combinations, balls-into-boxes, binomial theorem, inclusion-exclusion, generating functions, recurrences.
Enumeration is explicitly rejected as a method.
